CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content was provided.

COD.rationale: Content (red set), its organization (coordinate list) and a separate origin/status entry are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content labels (red/blue) with coordinate sets identify content and attribute.

D.rationale: Content entries are accompanied by separate origin/status metadata, distinguishing identity from status.

O.rationale: The report states spatial layout and gives coordinate sets that present how content is organized/presented.
